body.message:
Hello Tharushi Sha, 
I hope you’re doing well. I wanted to check if you currently have any holiday home/studio or 1-bedroom options available from June 16th until September 16th (approximately 3 months).

I’m ideally looking for a place with easy access to public transport, preferably near Dubai Investment Park (DIP) or with convenient connectivity to the area. I’m open to nearby locations as well if transport access is good.

I’m currently a master’s student in Dubai, and this would be for a 3-month stay, so I’m looking for something comfortable, convenient, and suitable for a longer-term arrangement. I’d love to know what options you may have available and whether there’s any flexibility on pricing for an extended stay.

Please feel free to share available options, locations, and monthly rates.

Looking forward to hearing from you. Thanks!
